author: Vincent Boucher — President of MONTREAL.AI
scope: Additive observation instrument on existing #4972 lifecycle; no new discovery infrastructure or publication reservation
selection_reason: A narrowly testable information-acquisition pilot grounded in an acknowledged failure mode; broad retry and replay novelty rejected. No scientifically novel algorithm or viable market assumed.
chronology: The general research-record scaffold and finite compiler were drafted during the opportunity investigation. This selection is fixed before the local end-to-end pilot runs; it is not a blind test of autonomous discovery.

candidates.outcome: Prevent duplicate remote effects after an acknowledgement failure
candidates.existing_approaches: Stripe and ECS accept request tokens; Temporal recommends idempotent activities and explains lost acknowledgements.
candidates.consequential_gap: These are strong incumbents. No new opportunity where a native exact request token is available.
candidates.required_construction: Use the existing endpoint semantics and the same parameters and token.
candidates.restriction: A native idempotency mechanism is not yet used
candidates.smallest_experiment: Check the real endpoint contract before constructing an adapter.
candidates.falsifier: A supported native mechanism already satisfies the recipient.
candidates.beneficiary: Operators delivering tool-mediated work with ambiguous completion
candidates.why_now: Frontier reasoning can propose mission-specific observations; bounded construction and checking can make them inspectable. Actual frontier superiority remains untested.
candidates.commercial_mechanism: Qualification and integration service priced against a matched human service when sourced, otherwise an explicit willingness-to-pay hypothesis. No customer demand, quote or sale is observed.
uncertainties: Complete engineering, provider, customer and maintenance cost unknown
No buyer commitment or recipient price evidence
Finite coverage does not cover concurrency or adversarial sources

candidates.outcome: Infer useful task completion from interoperable agent traces
candidates.existing_approaches: OpenTelemetry supplies common trace and operation semantics; tool success is recorded where available.
candidates.consequential_gap: An operation trace need not identify whether the original beneficiary outcome is satisfied.
candidates.required_construction: Bind recorded spans to mission-specific acceptance semantics and actual current-state evidence.
candidates.restriction: A successful transport span is used as a proxy for useful completion
candidates.smallest_experiment: Challenge the inference with successful transport and corrupted output.
candidates.falsifier: Trace inference accepts a wrong artifact or existing application checks solve the need.

candidates.outcome: Determine whether the exact intended artifact exists after an ambiguous tool result, while preserving uncertainty and the original mission
candidates.existing_approaches: Idempotency, application acceptance and durable workflows are primary incumbents. Exact hash inspection and finite distinguishing-set search are standard building blocks.
candidates.consequential_gap: For a tool without an adequate outcome read, acknowledged and unacknowledged worlds can be observationally identical. A purpose-specific read interface may distinguish them; reasoning alone cannot.
candidates.required_construction: Construct and execute a bounded read-only instrument tied to the original outcome; preserve HOLD when observations cannot separate success and failure.
candidates.restriction: Only an ambiguous acknowledgement is observed
alternatives: Manually construct the same direct byte checker
Stop when no authorized informative read exists
candidates.smallest_experiment: After an actual local child writes and exits before acknowledgement, compile authorized observations; use unchanged byte-level acceptance, then apply the actual retained compiler to a different artifact family.
candidates.falsifier: Any invalid artifact is classified satisfied; ambiguity is erased; a probe implies retry authority; or competent existing methods match and defeat the incremental-Alpha claim.
